einzeiler: Launch of the Investiture of the Gods episodes on Chinese Lore Podcast.
kurzfassung: The first episodes of Investiture of the Gods have been published. Listeners can find them on the Chinese Lore Podcast. The series is available across various podcast platforms and YouTube.
stichpunkte: Available on the Chinese Lore Podcast
Accessible on various podcast platforms and YouTube
beschreibung: Hi everyone. I want to let you know that I have posted the first episodes of Investiture of the Gods on the Chinese Lore Podcast. If you are not yet subscribed to that show, go to chineselore.com. You will find links to the show on various podcast platforms and on YouTube, as well as links to find me on social media and to review and support the show. If you like the podcast, a five-star rating on Apple Podcasts would be much appreciated. As always, thanks for listening!
